title: Lip Reading Sentences in the Wild
authors: Joon Son Chung, Andrew Senior, Oriol Vinyals, Andrew Zisserman
publisher: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Makalah fundamental pengenalan wicara visual (Watch, Listen, Attend and Spell) yang membuktikan keunggulan arsitektur sinkronisasi audio-visual end-to-end.

title: Look, Listen and Learn (L3-Net)
publisher: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
annotation: Mempelopori tugas dalih (pretext task) korespondensi audio-visual mandiri untuk mempelajari representasi visual dan akustik tanpa label manual.

title: Audio-Visual Scene Analysis with Self-Supervised Multisensory Features
annotation: Memperkenalkan analisis adegan audio-visual terpadu untuk pemisahan sumber suara spasial dan identifikasi komponen visual penghasil bunyi.

title: Attention Bottlenecks for Multimodal Fusion
authors: Arsha Nagrani, Shan Yang, Anurag Arnab, Aren Jansen, Cordelia Schmid, Chen Sun
publisher: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
annotation: Arsitektur Multimodal Bottleneck Transformer (MBT) yang mengintegrasikan aliran video dan audio melalui token perantara terkompresi.
